2486.unvetted: Nine Karolyi letters across four fascicles (C 65, G 218, H 239, B 22), most with only a word or two lines in figures. Checked 11 Nov: DECODE 'Karolyi' 0 records; Archivum Rakoczianum (archive.org full texts) prints Rakoczi's and Bercsenyi's letters, not Karolyi's. NOT opened, and they would cover the January 1711 letters (H Fasc. 239 fol. 24, 25-26): Lukinich, A szatmari beke tortenete es okirattara (1925) and Pulay's Szatmari bekesseg; neither is on archive.org and hungaricana is 403 here. Open those two, then split: the one promising piece is B Fasc. 22 fol. 86-87 ('a külcímet kivéve végig megfejtetlen számjelekkel', writer only guessed as Karolyi).

2487.unvetted: Eight letters of two writers in four fascicles. Checked 11 Nov: DECODE 'Horvath'/'Papai' hold only the Caps. C 33/36, D 80, E 109, H 226 sets; Lang 2015 has no row for Fasc. 79, 108, 233, 234. D Fasc. 79 fol. 19-20 is noted by MNL as 'utólag ceruzával megfejtett' (deciphered later in pencil), so it is read on the leaf. Not opened, not online here: Benda, Papai Janos torokorszagi naploi (1963) and Thaly, Bay Mihaly es Papai Gaspar naploja. Open them, drop D 79, and split Horvath's five 1710 letters (H Fasc. 233) from Papai Gaspar's.
